{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the fraction of converted loyal customers
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print the exact numbers that will be in the evidence
print(n_loyal)
print(converted_loyal)
print(fraction_converted)"}
